chapter: Hightower: New Orleans parades and early players
title: Bunk Johnson's downtown dance band
summary: Hightower recalls Bunk's playing the Carpenters Hall with the Superior Band, an all-Creole downtown group.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: and went to Los Angeles. I just wondered how Bunk played when he was real young. Did you ever hear him play parades? How was he on parades?
Well I don't know about parades. The most I knew about him was that dance band and most of those men were old men. Yeah. And he played at the Carpenters Hall downtown.
Yeah, yeah. He always played. He didn't play uptown at all. All that band stayed downtown, see. And as I said they were all French.
Yeah, the Superior Band I think.
Yeah, the Superior Band was the name of the band. That was the band.
